body: From the DM-267 review (orchestrator, this run): Metrics dashboard follow-ups to fix and pin — an epic whose only run executed nothing still reads '0.0% of base weight · no executed attempt' (MetricsSections.tsx:116-119 keys on empty measuredRunIds while the core falls back to the last run, spaceGrades.ts:432-433); 'removed after revision N' can name an older revision (useMetricsRead.ts:58-63: sort pinned revisions descending); stacked narrow tables use display:block and drop table semantics — keep accessible roles; delta fallback floors negatives (metricsView.ts:110: −0.04 shows −0.1).
